title: Flight Delay & Cancellation Tracker Input
description: Track flight delays and cancellations by flight number or route. IATA flight codes like UA1, BA112 are auto translated to FlightAware's ICAO format.

flightNumbers.title: Flight numbers
flightNumbers.description: Flight identifiers like UA1, BA112, AF22, LH400. IATA two letter codes are auto translated to ICAO. ICAO codes (UAL1, BAW112) work directly.

routes.title: Routes
routes.description: Origin to destination on a specific date. Format: array of objects with origin, destination (IATA codes like JFK, LAX), and date (YYYY-MM-DD). Example: [{"origin":"JFK","destination":"LAX","date":"2026-05-15"}]. Returns scheduled flights on that route.

minDelayMinutes.title: Minimum delay in minutes
minDelayMinutes.description: Drop rows with departure delay below this value. Set to 0 to keep on-time flights. Use 180 to focus on EU 261 eligible delays (3 hours and above).

includeStatuses.title: Statuses to keep
includeStatuses.description: Which flight statuses to push. Default keeps everything.

cancelledOnly.title: Cancellations and diversions only
cancelledOnly.description: Override status filter to keep only cancelled and diverted flights. Useful for travel insurance and EU 261 lead generation.

maxItemsPerSource.title: Max items per source
maxItemsPerSource.description: Cap on flights returned per flight number or route.

maxItemsTotal.title: Max items per run
maxItemsTotal.description: Hard cap across all sources. Controls total cost.

dedupe.title: Deduplicate across runs
dedupe.description: Skip flight rows already pushed in previous runs (key is ident plus scheduled departure). Turn off to track status changes for the same flight over time.

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy configuration
proxyConfiguration.description: Apify proxy. FlightAware blocks datacenter IPs aggressively. Residential is strongly recommended.
